newsitem.title: EGYPT: Jordan's king in Egypt for talks with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king in Egypt for talks with Mubarak.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein arrived in Egypt on Tuesday for talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak aimed at lending fresh impetus to stalled Middle East peace talks.
The two Arab leaders met in the Sinai resort of Sharm el-Sheikh.

Jordanian officials in Amman said they would try to find ways to bridge gaps between Israeli and Palestinian negotiators who have yet to seal an accord on a long overdue Israeli troop redeployment in the West Bank town of Hebron.

The king, seen as Israel's closest Arab ally since his 1994 peace treaty with the Jewish state, has distanced himself in recent weeks from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu after Netanyahu opened a tunnel entrance close to Moslem holy sites in Jerusalem in September, sparking widespread violence.
Jordanian Information Minister Marwan Muasher said the king's meeting with Mubarak was part of closer coordination between the two Arab states since the recent crisis.
